tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The executive engineer has the right to reject the tender at any time
Financial turnover of last three years shall be attach & any 3 years
All terms and Conditions as per tender Documents

Where the Supplier is required under the Contract to transport the Goods to a specified place of destination to concerned within India defined as Project site, transport to such place of destination in India including insurance, as shall be specified in the Contract, shall be arranged by the Supplier, and the related cost shall be included in the Contract Price.
Suppliers shall be entirely responsible for all taxes, duties, license fees, road permits, etc., incurred until delivery of the contracted Goods to the Purchaser
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance certificates issued by Govt officer not below the rank of Taluk/District level

Original copies of all the above documents (updated in the kppp portal) shall be produced by the Bidder on demand. The Executive Engineer, RDWS&SD, Raichur has the authority to accept and reject tenders
Entering the tender price should be inclusive of taxes payable to the State Government/Central Government and packing/handling/transporting charges and other expenses in the price list
The selected Bidder shall supply the furniture within the period mentioned above and shall not sub-contract for any reason

In case the bidder is inadequate to supply the items within the stipulated period or violates the conditions, Performance security Bank Guarantee amount will be forfeited and the supply order will be canceled and the firm will be recommended to be blacklisted
The power to cancel and accept the tender rests with the Executive Engineer, RDWS&SD Raichur
For further information, contact this office during office hours.
Bidders Details Should Upload Detailed Addres along with Bank Details
At the time of agreement successful bidder has to submit 5% as Security deposite and Additional security for unbalanced tender amount
Warranty as per bid document
For Any Errors/Correction In Bid Document/KPPP, EE RDWSD Division Raichur Decision is Final
